description: fp6_tworow with one FP_OBSTRUCTIONS box over the stripe-free gap between the top row's last macro (e3_hi, right edge x 1259.44) and the right core edge (1286.40). OpenROAD makes no CoreSite row under the box, so pdngen adds no short power strap there; the 32.96 um pair gaps are closed by src/config.json's FP_MACRO_HORIZONTAL_HALO 16.48, which this floorplan keeps (docs/6x4.md section 2).

derivation.rule: x from the top row's last macro edge to the core right edge; y from that macro's y minus the 10 um vertical halo to the core top edge

generator: hand-derived (docs/6x4.md section 2); variants6x4/row_islands.py models the obstruction
